---
name: Feature request
about: A backend, upload rule, plugin or integration the library lacks
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**What your app needs to do**

Describe the user-facing need, not the implementation. "Users upload a folder of photos and download them back as one zip" is more useful than "add a zip function".

**What you tried**

The drivers, policies and plugins you use today, and where they stopped. An interceptor, a records plugin or a driver of your own can add a lot; if you wrote one, say what it could not do.

**Who else ships it**

Products or libraries that offer the same thing. Features are ranked by how many real products ship them.
